title: Supply of 1000 MW Firm and Dispatchable RE Round-the-Clock (FDRE-RTC) power from ISTS-connected RE projects (issued as RTC-TM-V)
issuer: Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited (SECI)

documents.title: RfS
documents.summary: The tender: 1000 MW RTC-TM from ISTS-connected RE with storage, 25-year PPA from the SCSD, e-bidding and e-Reverse Auction, eligibility, guarantees, milestones and the bid formats (Section 7). Read with the amendments, which override it.

documents.title: Amendment-01
documents.summary: Bid size down to 50 MW; DFR now per time-block only (90% peak, 70% off-peak), annual DFR penalty dropped; Peak Hours window 18:00 to 10:00; phased SCSD; new technical criteria; revised penalty illustration.

documents.title: Amendment-02
documents.summary: BESS co-located with RE; SCSD back to 24 months for the full capacity; EMD, PBG and net worth revised; discrete-component power priced by hour type; clause 34.3 marked 'Not used'.

documents.title: Clarifications-01
documents.summary: SECI's answers to bidders' queries: most requests refused ('Tender conditions remain unchanged'); DFR, Peak Hours and technical criteria referred to the amendments.

documents.title: Amendment-03
documents.summary: Renames the tender SECI-FDRE-RTC-V. DFR per time-block now 90% in the Peak Hours, at least 50% and at most 60% in the Solar Hours, and 70% in the Remaining Hours; excess above 60% in the Solar Hours goes first to the Buying Entity at 50% of the tariff; connectivity must start by 31 Dec 2029; revised penalty illustration. Amends the PPA to match.

documents.ref: PSA, SECI and the Buying Entity

queries: No bid deadline in the RfS: Bid Information Sheet (K) says 'As per NIT on ISN-ETS portal' (p.4). The dates in cl. 26.1 (22.11.2026) and 37.1 (05.11.2026) are worked examples only (p.42, p.54).
No ceiling or maximum tariff anywhere in the RfS; SECI may only annul or cancel for high tariffs or no buyers (cl. 41.2-41.3, p.60). Ask whether an undisclosed benchmark exists.
PPA term is 25 years from the SCSD (cl. 20.2, p.34), not from the Effective Date; the pack's 'term' gap can be closed.
Cl. 34.3 (technical criterion) is 'Not used' per Amendment-02 while Clarifications-01 Q4 says it was 'suitably modified': still ask whether any experience test survives (RfS original p.50).
Cl. 34.1 says technology is declared 'in the prescribed Format 7.9' (p.50), but 7.9 is the Integrity Pact (p.106) and no format asks for technology. Ask where to declare it.

Cross-reference errors: cl. 26.2 lists formats 'as elaborated in Clause 22' and attachments 'under the sub-clause xi' (p.44), but they are cl. 23 and sub-clause x (p.38-39); Annexure-B says offline documents are 'as per Clause 29' (p.118), really cl. 26.1; cl. 12 points to Annexure-D for portal login (p.25), but Annexure-D is the progress report format (p.128).
Tariff validity cites three different clauses: cl. 28 cites 41.4 (p.45), Format 7.1 para 14 cites 41.5 (p.71), and Format 7.10 cites 'Clause 42.4' (p.107), which is a definition.

Cl. 23(ii) wants the consortium Power of Attorney 'in original' (p.38), but cl. 26.1 lists only the EMD instrument and pass-phrases as offline originals (p.42). Ask whether the original PoA must be couriered.

ESS unit for PBG: cl. 17.1 says the installed capacity for PBG includes ESS 'in MW' (p.29), but the formula's E and definition 42.48 use MWh (p.65-66). Success charges explicitly count ESS in MWh (p.32), so Rs 1 lakh x MWh could be large: worth confirming.

EMD (cl. 16.1), PBG (17.1) and net worth (35.1) scale with installed capacity (solar/wind MW, ESS MWh) but liquidity (35.2) and processing fee scale with contracted MW (p.27, p.29, p.51-52, p.4). The pack's EMD/PBG/net-worth model should take installed capacity, which bidders may revise up to SCSD.
Original cl. 6.1 let ESS sit anywhere (p.12) while definition 42.47 required co-location (p.65); Amendment-02 resolves this (BESS co-located, PSP may be separate).
Pack 'modules' marks domestic cells as an Amendment-01 change, but RfS cl. 34.4 already required ALMM List-II cells (p.50); Amendment-01 only revised the Annexure-A standards.
Annexure-A Sl. 9 (p.112) only shows a 50 MW solar row and requires DC arrays in 10 MW units, written for a solar-only tender. Its relevance to hybrid/RTC capacity is unclear.

Last-bidder rule after Amendment-01: 'lower than 50% of the total quoted capacity ... or 50 MW' (p.59; amd1 p.5) does not say whether the lower or higher threshold governs. Format 7.1 para 7 commits the bidder to accept any offer of 50% or more (p.70).

Substation SCD: cl. 7.5 still needs the initial substation's SCD on or before 30.06.2028 with proof (p.14), but Amendment-01 dropped that condition for later Delivery Point changes up to the connectivity deadline. Confirm a changed substation has no SCD limit.
PBG validity is SCSD + 9 months (p.29); with SCSD now 24 months (Amendment-02) a PBG must run about 33 months from the Effective Date. Bank tenor and cost should use the amended SCSD.
Annexure-C in the RfS (p.125-127) still shows 80% off-peak and the annual DFR penalty; Amendment-01 replaced it. Use only the revised Annexure-C.

Cl. 8.2(a) says shortfall penalties are as 'provided in the PSA' (p.18). The Standard PSA in the pack still carries the pre-Amendment-01 DFR, so the PSA wording should be confirmed as amended (Amendment-01 amends PSA 2.11.3).

No land milestone before commissioning: land possession proof is due only with the pre-trial-run documents (p.20), and FC (cl. 21.2, p.36) asks only for financing and equipment, so a land-readiness check at FC is not in the RfS.
